concepts.name: Measurement of Length and Motion
concepts.definition: Central learning focus of Measurement of Length and Motion.
concepts.source_evidence: The shopkeeper measures the cloth using a metal measuring rod.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Support a conclusion with source information or valid working.
concepts.source_evidence: Then, the tailor takes her measurements using a flexible measuring tape.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Transfer the learned idea to a relevant new context.
concepts.source_evidence: Her mother instructs the tailor to increase the length of her uniform by char angula (four fingers width).
